tone.description: Named accent for this beat's highlight: accent (orange, default), info (blue), success (green), warn (amber), danger (red), neutral (slate). Resilience aliases survive/degrade/severed still work.

color.description: Arbitrary hex accent (e.g. '#8C4FFF') overriding `tone` for this beat's card + highlights.

cardSide.description: Where the overlay card sits: right (default), left, top (flows above the canvas), or full (centered full-page modal with a dimmed backdrop — good for an intro/overview beat).

nodes.description: Service ids highlighted (tinted) in this beat.

edges.description: Connection ids highlighted in this beat.

groups.description: Group ids tinted (border+glow) in this beat.

tones.description: Per-node tone override: { nodeId: tone } — use when a beat mixes tones (e.g. one node danger, rest accent).

zoom.description: Node/group ids to frame the camera on this beat (requires stepZoom). Empty array = fit the whole diagram.

maxZoom.description: Max zoom level when framing this beat (default 2.2). Lower it (e.g. 1.4) to keep more context visible.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the card title, e.g. '1 · Ingress'.

icon.description: Icon reference shown next to the card title (same resolution as service icon).

body.description: Card description paragraph. Supports inline markdown: **bold**, `code`, *italic*.

code.description: A fenced code/snippet block rendered under the body in monospace (e.g. an HTTP request, a CLI command, a YAML fragment). Preserves whitespace/newlines and scrolls horizontally.

codeLabel.description: Small uppercase label shown on the code block's header bar (e.g. 'REQUEST', 'bash', 'JumpStartModel.yaml').

badge.description: Override the tone badge label; false hides it (recommended for architecture walkthroughs — the eyebrow already labels the beat).

bullets.description: Bullet list under the body. Each item is a plain string, or a styled object {text, strong?, color?, icon?, glyph?} for richer bullets.

process.description: A numbered process list rendered as colored numbered bubbles + label + description (like a migration runbook: SCT → DMS → Cutover). Use for an ordered sequence of stages inside one card.

label.description: Bold colored step name (e.g. 'SCT', 'DMS full load').

color.description: Hex accent for this step's number bubble + label (e.g. '#8C4FFF'). Defaults to the beat tone.

ok.description: If true, the numbered bubble shows a ✓ instead of the number (a completed step).

chips.description: Status chips row at the bottom of the card.

ok.description: Status glyph: true=green ✓, false=red ✗, 'warn'=amber ≈, omit=neutral dot.

icon.description: Icon reference shown inside the chip.

costUrl.description: Link to an external cost estimate for this beat (e.g. an AWS Pricing Calculator share URL). Renders a clickable pill on the card that opens in a new tab. Only a link — this server does not price anything. Use one estimate per sizing scenario. The first step with a costUrl also feeds the dock button when the top-level `costUrl` is omitted.

costLabel.description: Label for this beat's cost pill (default: the localized 'Cost estimate').

sections.description: Rich documentation sections (title + body + bullets each). Mainly for a full-page overview beat (cardSide:'full') that reads like a system README — scrolls if long.

bullets.description: Section bullet list (same string-or-styled-object format as step bullets).
